projects.name: Dockyard
projects.tagline: Messy customer exports, explainable clean records.
projects.description: Normalize a CRM CSV, quarantine identity conflicts, and retain cell-level lineage.
projects.customer: A customer-success team migrating two acquired CRMs

projects.name: ProofDesk
projects.tagline: Evidence that respects the permission boundary.
projects.description: Resolve document versions, enforce tenant and role access, rank lexical evidence, or abstain.
projects.customer: An enterprise support team searching conflicting customer policies

projects.name: EvalForge
projects.tagline: Make the release decision explain itself.
projects.description: A paired acceptance bench that gates agent changes on answers, evidence, abstention, critical failures, cost and latency.
projects.customer: Enterprise AI teams replacing an agent or changing its prompts and tools.

projects.name: LedgerGuard
projects.tagline: Every invoice decision has a receipt trail.
projects.description: Reconcile invoices against purchase orders and goods receipts with exact money and review holds.
projects.customer: A procurement team reconciling supplier invoices across currencies

projects.name: Relay
projects.tagline: Replay chaos. Deliver each local state transition once.
projects.description: A durable webhook inbox/outbox with tenant-scoped deduplication, retries, dead letters and version ordering.
projects.customer: A SaaS integration team receiving duplicate and out-of-order order webhooks.

projects.name: Switchboard
projects.tagline: Find the blast radius before proposing the fix.
projects.description: Correlate service failures, dependency impact and recent deploys in a reviewable incident brief.
projects.customer: A SaaS platform's on-call engineering team

projects.name: RouteCraft
projects.tagline: Make promises the fleet can actually keep.
projects.description: Construct feasible delivery routes and explain every unassigned job under capacity, time-window and shift constraints.
projects.customer: A regional distributor planning a small delivery fleet

projects.name: ConsentLine
projects.tagline: Give a workflow the minimum data it is allowed to use.
projects.description: Purpose-bound redaction, keyed pseudonyms, span-level evidence and a fail-closed egress decision for synthetic support text.
projects.customer: A support platform sharing ticket excerpts with an external analysis vendor

projects.name: ShiftForge
projects.tagline: Turn an overloaded order book into a feasible shift.
projects.description: Schedule dependent manufacturing jobs against machine skills, release times and maintenance windows.
projects.customer: A small manufacturer coordinating production and customer promises

projects.name: LaunchGate
projects.tagline: A release decision that explains its evidence.
projects.description: An inspectable canary gate combining traffic sufficiency, SLO burn, latency and baseline regression.
projects.customer: A platform team deciding whether to expand, pause or roll back a customer-facing release.
